newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Deposition sees improvement in 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Deposition sees improvement in 2nd half.

text.p: Advanced Deposition Technologies Inc said on Tuesday that all of its operations are showing improvements and it expects this trend to continue throughout the second half of the year.

Glenn Walters, president and CEO, said in a statement "Based upon improvements in all of our operations and additional licensing revenues, net earnings for the (second) quarter (ended June 30) were up 25 percent from the first quarter.
"We see this trend continuing throughout the year based upon growing market interest in our revolutionary products and as operating profits continue to improve," added Walters.

Walters continued, "These trends should allow us to meet or exceed current 'Street' estimates of $14 million in revenues and earnings of $0.30 to $0.33 per share which will be a record performance for A. D. Tech."
Advanced Deposition develops and manufactures patterned metallized films for energy management used in electronics, microwave food packaging and other industries.
